summary: Akamai Technologies filed an 8-K announcing the pricing of $1.5 billion in 0% convertible senior notes due 2030 and $1.5 billion due 2032, upsized from $1.3 billion each, in a Rule 144A private offering with an underwriter option for an additional $250 million per tranche. The notes are senior unsecured, carry no regular interest, and mature in May 2030 and 2032. Proceeds are not specified but typically fund share buybacks, capex, or general corporate purposes. The offering closes May 22, 2026. Watch for dilution risk from conversion and any announced capital return program.
